transcription_uncertainties.explanation: Actual Charles main text contains these three stars. Preserve the selected readings and critical qualification; no alternative manuscript or passive form is adopted. The nominative wisdom and final main-text le are not normalized away. This is not a claim to the ancient autograph or complete manuscript agreement.

translation.text: And the wisdom of the Lord of Spirits brought revelation to the holy and the righteous.[a] For he reserved their share for the righteous, because they hated and rejected this world of unrighteousness. They hated all its deeds and its ways in the name of the Lord of Spirits, because in his own name they will be saved. And by his will it was for their life.[b]

footnotes.text: This follows the selected active starredከሠተ, not an added passive form. The printedጥበቡ is the nominative form of his wisdom; its followingለእግዚአመንፈሳት identifies the possessor, the Lord of Spirits, by an anticipatory-suffix construction. Dillmann1865 columns1229–1230 treats wisdom as either masculine or feminine; therefore the masculine active verb does not require an unnamed male revealer with wisdom as its object. Dillmann1907 section154 pages354–356 distinguishes the singular consonant-stem nominative suffix-u from accusative-o, while section172 pages426–428 explains the suffix-plus-le construction. Brought revelation renders the active act without inventing an explicit object, since the selected verb prints none. The real stars are preserved in the source; no reported alternative reading is adopted.

The complete final selected clause readsወበፈቃዱኮነለሕይወቶሙ, including main-textለ before their life. The raised13 afterለ is only an apparatus callout, and its note says that a omits; this does not license dropping selected le. The English retains the compressed it was for their life relation instead of changing it into the unqualified statement that their life came into existence. No additional named subject is supplied. Throughout this unit, the personal suffixes and the repeated Lord of Spirits title are retained without identifying an additional person.
